description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Nabaat)] and [Dark Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Nabaat)
description.text: Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Black Gear every Dark attack

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Dark Mode II (Nabaat)], removes [Dual Awoken Dark Mode I (Nabaat)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Dark Mode II (Nabaat)

description.name: Dual Black Gear
description.text: Two single attacks (4.20 each), causes [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] every second use

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3
